clusters.query: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE category = ? ORDER BY price
clusters.setup: CREATE TABLE products (name TEXT, price REAL, category TEXT); INSERT INTO products VALUES ('Apple', 1.50, 'food'), ('Bread', 3.00, 'food'), ('Hammer', 12.99, 'tools'), ('Banana', 0.75, 'food');

clusters.query: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
clusters.setup: CREATE TABLE products (name TEXT, category TEXT); INSERT INTO products VALUES ('Apple', 'food'), ('Bread', 'food'), ('Hammer', 'tools'), ('Banana', 'food'), ('Wrench', 'tools');
